items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: There's a music star I deal with there. He know all about us. Peterson.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, you taught me that.

Yeah. You know who can make you laugh about that? There's a music star I deal with there. He know all about us. Peterson. Oh yeah. 734 and out broad between the Orleans and Cincinnati. You can tell you, I was a brother of the people. He said, I'm sitting there right there. He said, you don't have about six men. He said, I'll tell you, I was going to have six men and seven pieces. And the guy got to me and said, no, you see that's nine drummers, that's one. But that's a big drum. He said, if you don't do that,…
Who was that second liner that was a peddler or something too that you were telling me about?
